title: Lead/Inquiry Capture → AI Score & Draft → Dynamics CRM → Route Sales or Support

sections.label: 1 · CAPTURE & ORGANIZE
sections.note: Every inquiry gets normalized and checked against Dynamics before anything else happens, so nothing becomes a duplicate record.

sections.label: 2 · AI SCORE & DRAFT
sections.note: One AI step classifies whether this is a sales lead or a support need and drafts the first response either way.

sections.label: 3 · SYNC TO DYNAMICS
sections.note: The record and the interaction both get logged, so the CRM stays the source of truth, not a spreadsheet on the side.

sections.label: 4 · ROUTE SALES OR SUPPORT
sections.note: Sales-ready leads notify a rep, support requests go to the queue, and the drafted response goes out either way.

nodes.label: Check Dynamics CRM for an Existing Record
Score the Lead, Classify Sales vs Support, and Draft a First Response
Create or Update the Record in Dynamics CRM
Log the Interaction and Drafted Response as an Activity
Classified as Sales-Ready or Support Request?
Notify Sales Rep: New Qualified Lead
Route to Support Queue for Review
Send the Drafted Response to the Contact
